features.note: Cutaway shows a ribbed/banded machined body with two flanged top ports, a toothed drive coupling at the motor end, end caps and a brass oil-sight fitting — reads as a machined screw block, not a smooth cylinder.
Closed sheet-metal box with real panel gaps, hinged access door, latch clips, handle, lifting ring, low slat grille and stamped 'A' branding — matches the GA access-panel front.
airend -> copper discharge -> vertical separator -> piping to aftercooler -> outlet valve at low front, correct order, ports joined; no floating stubs.
Cooler view: square radiator block with a large axial fan behind a wire finger-guard cage at -X. Strong, unambiguous.
Front face: recessed dark display + red mushroom e-stop + nameplate. Form present and legible; display content is a later pass.

important_features.note: Finned TEFC cylinder with top terminal box, rear cooling cowl/fan and guarded coupling to the airend.
Copper lines routed airend->separator->cooler->outlet valve, terminating at real ports.
'AIRTECH / ROTARY SCREW 45 kW / S/N' plate reads as printed spec text; brand-neutral.

defects: HMI display face reads as a flat black panel with no screen-content differentiation from its bezel.
E-stop mushroom sits directly on the display panel rather than on its own labeled base beside the screen.
Separator vessel reads slightly tall/thin relative to the enclosure envelope.
Airend drive coupling reads a bit gear-like rather than a smooth flexible-coupling/guard hub.
corrections: Give the HMI display a proud inset screen plane distinct from the bezel; move the e-stop to its own raised collar base beside the screen.
Widen the separator vessel diameter to match the ~0.36 m dia / ~1.05 m height proportion.
Reshape the coupling into a cylindrical guard/hub silhouette rather than a toothed gear profile.
